name: io.github.doublegate/cyberchef-mcp
description: CyberChef's 504 data-transformation operations -- encryption, encoding, compression, forensics -- as MCP tools, with prompts for common analysis workflows.
_comment: The npm record was ABSENT until v3.0.0, and should not have been: cyberchef-mcp has been on the registry since 2.5.0 -- seven versions -- while this file, docs/wiki/Installation.md, docs/wiki/FAQ.md and AGENTS.md all said it was publishable but unpublished. The comment here even said to add the record in the same change that publishes it, and nothing did. Verified with `npm view cyberchef-mcp versions` before writing this. The version fields are gated by `npm run check:versions`, which this file was outside of until v3.0.0 and had been stale at 2.4.1 for six releases as a result.
